prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access from here to pull up current local listings, but I can help you find reliable backflow testing and repair providers near Liberty, MO and tell you what to look for. Do you want residential or commercial service? If you want, tell me your ZIP and I’ll give a tailored search plan and a script you can use when contacting companies.

Quick steps to find someone now
- Contact the City of Liberty Water Division / Public Works — they can usually provide a list of certified backflow testers who work in the city or tell you any local certification requirements. (Search: “City of Liberty MO water department backflow”)
- Search Google Maps / Yelp / Angi / HomeAdvisor for “backflow tester Liberty MO” or “backflow preventer testing Liberty MO.” Look for companies with recent reviews and backflow-specific services listed.
- Check for national/regional plumbing firms with local branches (for example: Roto-Rooter, Mr. Rooter or other large plumbing companies often do backflow testing and repairs).
- Search the Missouri state or county list of certified backflow testers if one exists (some states keep a list of certified testers or plumbers).

What to check before hiring
- Certification: Ask whether the technician is a certified backflow tester in Missouri (or certified through an accepted program). Ask for certificate or tester license number.
- Experience: Ask how many tests/repairs they perform monthly and whether they work on your type of device (residential vs. commercial assemblies).
- Insurance and bonding: Confirm they carry liability insurance.
- Reporting: Confirm they will submit the test report to the water utility if required (many utilities require submission of test results).
- Warranty: Ask about warranty on repair parts and workmanship.
- Price: Get a written quote for testing and an estimate for common repairs; ask if there are service-call fees.

Questions to ask when you call (quick script)
- “Are you a certified backflow tester in Missouri? Can you provide your certification number?”
- “Do you regularly test and repair backflow prevention assemblies for [residential/commercial] customers?”
- “Do you provide the required test report to the city/water utility?”
- “What’s your testing fee and typical repair hourly rate or parts pricing?”
- “Are you insured and bonded?”

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial and I’ll prepare a short list of likely provider names/types and a ready-to-use phone/email script to contact them.
